    base = sandbox.add_beam(x=5.0, y=9.8, width=0.6, height=0.4, angle=0, density=1.5)
    sandbox.add_joint(gantry, base, (5.0, 10.0), type='rigid')

    # Slider: Wider to accommodate finger spacing
    slider = sandbox.add_beam(x=5.0, y=7.6, width=0.6, height=2.0, angle=0, density=1.0)
    sandbox.set_fixed_rotation(slider, True)
    slider_joint = sandbox.add_joint(
        base, slider, (5.0, 9.6), type='slider',
        axis=(0, -1), lower_translation=0.0, upper_translation=8.0,
        enable_motor=True, motor_speed=1.2, max_motor_force=5000.0
    )

    # Fingers: Positioned at the bottom of the slider, pointing upward
    slider_bottom_y = 7.6 - 1.0  # Bottom of the slider beam
    slider_left = 5.0 - 0.3      # Left side of the slider
    slider_right = 5.0 + 0.3     # Right side of the slider

    left_finger = sandbox.add_beam(x=slider_left, y=slider_bottom_y, width=0.2, height=0.5, angle=math.pi / 2, density=2.0)

        lower_limit=-math.pi / 2, upper_limit=math.pi / 2

        lower_limit=-math.pi / 2, upper_limit=math.pi / 2
